guidetextdraw._value:
INSTRUCTIONS: Before further action can be taken on your financial aid application, the following information is required. Please verify information regarding the value your (and your spouse’s) investments and real estate, excluding your principal residence. Incomplete documents will not be returned. They will be disposed of in a secure manner, per university policy. This will delay processing.

Attach copies of the documentation used to calculate the value and debt of items listed in Action to Complete tab. Several documents may be used to verify real estate or investment value and debt (e.g., statements from a real estate office, mortgage statement, local newspaper ads, and/or comparable property listings)
guidetextdraw.name: textdraw1671624916373

guidetextdraw._value:
ACTION TO COMPLETE FORM:
Enter a value in each line below for the value of your (and your spouse’s) investments as of the day your FAFSA was filed. Do not leave blank spaces, use zeroes or N/A when appropriate.

Investment Value - List the value and debt of your (and your spouse’s) investments. Investments include: college savings plans, trust funds, money market funds, mutual funds, certificates of deposit, stocks, bonds, other securities, installment and land sale contracts (including mortgages held), commodities, precious and strategic metals, etc. Do not include the value of life insurance and retirement plans (pension funds, annuities, IRAs, Keogh plans, etc.)
guidetextdraw.name: textdraw1671625185492

guidetextdraw_1652728516._value: Real Estate Investment Value - List the value and debt of your (and your spouse’s) real estate investments, please exclude your principal residence. Other real estate includes rental property, land, second or summer homes, the rental portion of family home that maintains a separate entrance, etc. In determining real estate value, indicate the expected market value if the properties were sold today. List each property separately.
guidetextdraw_1652728516.name: textdraw_16527285161671625409234
